entities.name: Yisan
entities.description: Human rogue and bard from Shandalar who summons beasts with his lyre Tolumnus.

entities.name: Lesh
entities.description: Town where Yisan and Jalira picked pockets.

entities.name: Hastric
entities.description: Thunian whose journal described the route to the Skep; he was transformed into a sliver.

entities.name: Dexros
entities.description: Commander of the guard who caught the thieves.

entities.name: Skep
entities.description: Place with sliver caves where many died.

entities.name: Sliver Hivelord
entities.description: Sliver who returned Yisan and Jalira to human form and let them leave.

entities.name: Kapsho
entities.description: Place ruled by Talrand that they avoided.

entities.name: Hum
entities.description: The telepathic voice of every sliver combined.

events.summary: Yisan and Jalira rob Hastric but are caught by Dexros; Yisan keeps Hastric's journal describing the route to the Skep.
events.quote: Yisan kept Hastric's journal, which described the route to the Skep.

events.summary: They journey toward the Skep seeking riches from corpses, passing the Onakke catacombs and Kalonian Wilds and avoiding Kapsho.
events.quote: staying away from Kapsho and its ruler, Talrand .

events.summary: At the sliver caves Yisan and Jalira are transformed into slivers and join the Hum; the Sliver Hivelord returns them to human form.
events.quote: when the Sliver Hivelord crossed paths with them, they found themselves returning to their normal human selves

events.summary: The two are allowed to take loot and leave; Jalira goes to Martyne while Yisan stays to study the slivers, mimicking their hum.
events.quote: Yisan opted to skip out on his share and instead stay in the Skep to study the creatures.

relations.quote: Yisan and his adventuring partner, Jalira

relations.note: caught and forced him to return stolen goods
relations.quote: He forced them to return the stolen items
